description.ncbi_summary: Predicted to enable G protein-coupled peptide receptor activity and leukotriene B4 receptor activity. Predicted to be involved in inflammatory response and neuropeptide signaling pathway. Predicted to act upstream of or within keratinocyte migration and signal transduction. Located in nucleoplasm and plasma membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Apr 2022]

uniprot_function.text: Low-affinity receptor for leukotrienes including leukotriene B4. Mediates chemotaxis of granulocytes and macrophages. The response is mediated via G proteins that activate a phosphatidylinositol-calcium second messenger system. The rank order of affinities for the leukotrienes is LTB4 > 12-epi-LTB4 > LTB5 > LTB3.
